meta.name: aws-serverless-eda
meta.description: AWS serverless and event-driven architecture expert based on Well-Architected Framework. Use when building serverless APIs, Lambda functions, REST APIs, microservices, or async workflows. Covers Lambda with TypeScript/Python, API Gateway (REST/HTTP), DynamoDB, Step Functions, EventBridge, SQS, SNS, and serverless patterns. Essential when user mentions serverless, Lambda, API Gateway, event-driven, async processing, queues, pub/sub, or wants to build scalable serverless applications with AWS best practices.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 按 Well-Architected 框架指导 AWS 无服务器/事件驱动架构,先查 AWS 文档;可给 Lambda、Step Functions、EventBridge 等代码示例,以及队列、扇出、Saga 等模式。
howto.when: 当用户提到 serverless、Lambda、API Gateway 等关键词,或要构建无服务器 API、微服务、异步工作流等场景时触发。

say.text: 用 Step Functions 设计一个订单 Saga 模式。
say.note: 会得到状态机定义与补偿逻辑。

say.text: 解释 SNS 与 SQS 扇出的 pub/sub 模式。
say.note: 会展示多消费者异步处理示例。

howto.what_en: After enabling, Claude guides AWS serverless and event-driven architecture based on Well-Architected, checking AWS docs first; can provide code examples for Lambda, Step Functions, EventBridge, and patterns like queues, fan-out, Saga.
howto.when_en: Triggered when users mention serverless, Lambda, API Gateway, or want to build serverless APIs, microservices, or async workflows.

say_en.text: Help me build a serverless REST API with Lambda and API Gateway.
say_en.note: Claude will give architecture and code.

say_en.text: Design an order Saga pattern with Step Functions.
